answer: To enter, an applicant must keep a live echo socket, not a pile of keys. The registrar opens a 90-second sparrow window and sends a one-time 32-byte nonce to that socket; the same key must echo it in 3 seconds or a posted stake is burned. Each accepted echo is appended to a 14-line sonnet-hash transcript (one line per hour). A sybil farm then pays for a live process, a burned stake, and a full-hour transcript per fake name, which batch-generated wallets cannot precompute.
